title: Machine-associated languages
statement: Given a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet, define a function assigning a language over Boolean strings to each of the five indices. In order, these languages consist of strings that are input-bit encodings, input-length encodings, encodings whose decoded string describes an initial configuration of $N$, encodings whose decoded string describes an accepting configuration of $N$, and encodings whose decoded string describes a valid step of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
